title: Coast Guard restricts sea travel in parts of Bicol

blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — The Philippine Coast Guard has restricted sea travel in parts of Camarines Sur, Camarines Norte and Catanduanes as Super Typhoon Rosal threatens the Bicol region with strong winds and rough seas. Lt. Junior Grade Alyzza Novie Bermal, information officer of the Coast Guard District Bicol, told the Inquirer in a text message on Thursday that all vessels and watercraft in Catanduanes’ northeastern municipalities of Pandan, Bagamanoc, Panganiban, Viga and Gigmoto were barred from sailing, except those heading to designated safe shelters.
